t: This is Montagu Square, a long garden square in Marylebone, about five hundred and fifty metres north of Marble Arch. The long sides are lined with Grade II listed homes. Many lives have passed through them. Sir Maurice Cassidy, physician to the King from 1937 until his death, lived here. Rear-Admiral John Maitland, who served in the Napoleonic Wars, died here. Stacey Gregg, the actress who played Sandy in the original London stage production of Grease, was born here. Scot Young, the property developer who featured in a bitter and well-publicised divorce case, died here too.
